first_order_linear_nonhomogeneous.latex: y' + ay = f(x) \implies y = y_c + y_p
formulas: y' + ay = f(x)
y_c: \text{ general solution of } y' + ay = 0
y_p: \text{ particular solution of } y' + ay = f(x)
y = y_c + y_p
ay'' + by' + cy = 0, \quad a \neq 0
\text{Characteristic equation: } a\lambda^2 + b\lambda + c = 0, \quad \Delta = b^2 - 4ac
\Delta > 0,\ \lambda_1 \neq \lambda_2 \in \mathbb{R}: y = Ae^{\lambda_1 x} + Be^{\lambda_2 x}
\Delta = 0,\ \lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = \lambda_0: y = (Ax+B)e^{\lambda_0 x}
\Delta < 0,\ \lambda = \alpha \pm \beta i: y = (A\cos\beta x + B\sin\beta x)e^{\alpha x}

y = y_c + y_p
